szenen.vo: [intense] Your comfort zone feels safe, warm and easy. That's exactly why it's dangerous.
[intense] Nothing grows in there, bro. Not your skills, not your money, not you.
[intense] Days turn into months, months turn into years, and you're still standing in the same place.
[intense] Outside, it gets scary first. Then you learn. Then you grow.
[shouting] Everything you want is waiting one step outside that circle!
[intense] Feeling uncomfortable? That's not a stop sign. That's proof you're growing.
[intense] So do one thing today that scares you. Just one.
[shouting] Get out of the circle and grow!
